description:
Get rich slowly. On purpose.

The Boring Rich Club makes personal finance simple for regular Americans, with short animated videos and no hype. No stock tips, no crypto pumps, no "get rich quick". Just the boring steps that actually build wealth: budgeting, emergency funds, paying off credit card debt, your 401(k) and Roth IRA, index funds, and staying invested when the market drops.

New videos every day:
• Full guides (6–10 min) at 3 PM ET
• Shorts at 7 PM ET

What you'll learn:
• How to start investing from $0
• 401(k) match, Roth IRA and HSA basics
• Index funds and ETFs for beginners
• Getting out of credit card debt
• Money mistakes that keep people broke
• Scam red flags and "too good to be true" offers

📌 Educational content only. Not financial advice. Do your own research or talk to a licensed professional.
